record.bible_text: <FO><FO>A Psalm<WH04210> <FI>and<Fi> Song<WH07892> <FI>at<Fi> the dedication<WH02598> of the house<WH01004> of David<WH01732>.<Fo><Fo> I will extol<WH07311><WTH8787> thee, O LORD<WH03068>; for thou hast lifted me up<WH01802><WTH8765>, and hast not made my foes<WH0341><WTH8802> to rejoice<WH08055><WTH8765> over me.
O LORD<WH03068> my God<WH0430>, I cried<WH07768><WTH8765> unto thee, and thou hast healed<WH07495><WTH8799> me.

O LORD<WH03068>, thou hast brought up<WH05927><WTH8689> my soul<WH05315> from the grave<WH07585>: thou hast kept me alive<WH02421><WTH8765>, that I should not go down<WH03381><WTH8800><WTH8675><WH03381><WTH8802> to the pit<WH0953>.
Sing<WH02167><WTH8761> unto the LORD<WH03068>, O ye saints<WH02623> of his, and give thanks<WH03034><WTH8685> at the remembrance<WH02143> of his holiness<WH06944>. <RF>at...: or, to the memorial<Rf>

For his anger<WH0639> <FI>endureth but<Fi> a moment<WH07281>; in his favour<WH07522> <FI>is<Fi> life<WH02416>: weeping<WH01065> may endure<WH03885><WTH8799> for a night<WH06153>, but joy<WH07440> <FI>cometh<Fi> in the morning<WH01242>. <RF>his anger...: Heb. there is but a moment in his anger<Rf> <RF>for a night: Heb. in the evening<Rf> <RF>joy: Heb. singing<Rf><CM>
And in my prosperity<WH07959> I said<WH0559><WTH8804>, I shall never<WH05769> be moved<WH04131><WTH8735>.

LORD<WH03068>, by thy favour<WH07522> thou hast made my mountain<WH02042> to stand<WH05975><WTH8689> strong<WH05797>: thou didst hide<WH05641><WTH8689> thy face<WH06440>, <FI>and<Fi> I was troubled<WH0926><WTH8737>. <RF>made...: Heb. settled strength for my mountain<Rf>
I cried<WH07121><WTH8799> to thee, O LORD<WH03068>; and unto the LORD<WH03068> I made supplication<WH02603><WTH8691>.

What profit<WH01215> <FI>is there<Fi> in my blood<WH01818>, when I go down<WH03381><WTH8800> to the pit<WH07845>? Shall the dust<WH06083> praise<WH03034><WTH8686> thee? shall it declare<WH05046><WTH8686> thy truth<WH0571>?
Hear<WH08085><WTH8798>, O LORD<WH03068>, and have mercy<WH02603><WTH8798> upon me: LORD<WH03068>, be thou my helper<WH05826><WTH8802>.
Thou hast turned<WH02015><WTH8804> for me my mourning<WH04553> into dancing<WH04234>: thou hast put off<WH06605><WTH8765> my sackcloth<WH08242>, and girded<WH0247><WTH8762> me with gladness<WH08057>;

To the end that <FI>my<Fi> glory<WH03519> may sing<WH02167><WTH8762> praise to thee, and not be silent<WH01826><WTH8799>. O LORD<WH03068> my God<WH0430>, I will give thanks<WH03034><WTH8686> unto thee for ever<WH05769>. <RF>my glory: that is, my tongue, or, my soul<Rf><CM>
